test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOTbelong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)

1) ADBC

2) JMKL

3) FJHI

4) VYWX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) ADBC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be6aed30eaf2f9a82680c5f6f77ebe0c3467f5b40f52e4b8db8f57c597687884.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba1dc1fa59ed382a0ffba1f1c5232914757bbd18c20c7e354396d1dc4af6f4d0.png] 

Option 2) VYWX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/739b8acaf1b561645526786e163dabad83d703bc8e3d2667e0e21d972acbe23f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52103ac46dc00379adef93f1a0916ff11c50ed3df8f99d5b3016e42f8121f581.png] 

Option 3) JMKL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6b60d69d35d03f67862357f8c954538b2b3a9a3a889b8439354b87f11c6e446.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cc386ab8226141dd32e3fd45ae01f746932bddff7d8c47a7a33e277698c0519.png] 

Option 4) FJHI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe02419b0aac54e11afa0449f7eb34bd03b2fdf32a228e6e59f2e7bee3e939b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bc5b327fadf9f2b2ab6359bfef2154227cd5dfaa57339ba36245b2f8aafe815.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'FJHI' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
